title: No Entry to the Sun
description: A surreal desert scene features a large green-skinned woman with flowing green hair and purple lips rising from cracked sand dunes, her head crowned by a massive stylized sun with red rays. In the foreground, a red octagonal 'NO' sign with a barcode is chained to five colorful circular portraits of women's faces in green, blue, yellow, pink, and another green.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with a giant vibrant green-skinned woman with long flowing green hair and purple lips emerging from cracked sand dunes, a massive stylized sun with red rays and black stitches behind her head, in the foreground a red octagonal NO sign with a barcode covered in purple vines and chains attached to five colorful circular medallions containing portraits of women with various skin tones and hairstyles in green blue yellow and pink, scattered white paint splatters, vibrant and symbolic composition
